# OIDC_PROVIDER

An OIDC issuer, its endpoints, and the CR a consumer registers a client with.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `oidc`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.oidc`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
